Puerto Rico municipality SVG map

Source: @svg-maps/puerto-rico / MapSVG
Repository: https://github.com/VictorCazanave/svg-maps/tree/master/packages/puerto-rico
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
License URL: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Local modifications made for application use:
- Added data-municipality to each municipality path.
- Normalized path IDs to lowercase ASCII kebab-case.
- Merged the two Mayaguez geometry path components into one SVG path so there are exactly 78 municipality paths.

Suggested attribution:
"Puerto Rico municipality map adapted from MapSVG / @svg-maps/puerto-rico, licensed CC BY 4.0."
